entities.name: Janik
entities.description: A shaman of the Zhur-Taa clan of the Gruul on Ravnica and part of Nikya's war party.

entities.name: Nikya of the Old Ways
entities.description: A Gruul leader who declared war on the Rakdos over the perceived killing of the infant Zi.

entities.name: Kal
entities.description: A Gruul shaman who tracked the war party and saved the day with a blast of fire.

entities.name: Zi
entities.description: A Gruul infant who survived the massacre and was in the care of his uncle Ruzi.

entities.name: Ruzi
entities.description: Zi's uncle, who cared for him.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: Led a Rakdos massacre of a Selesnyan vernadi.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of which Janik's clan is part.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The guild that attacked Nikya's war party.

entities.name: Selesnya
entities.description: The guild whose vernadi was massacred.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where the Gruul live.

events.summary: Massacre Girl leads a Rakdos massacre of a nearby Selesnyan vernadi.
events.quote: Massacre Girl led a Rakdos massacre of a Selesnyan vernadi nearby

events.summary: Nikya declares war on the Rakdos, swearing revenge over the perceived killing of the Gruul infant Zi.
events.quote: Nikya of the Old Ways declared war on the Rakdos

events.summary: Janik nearly skewers Kal, who tracked the war party.
events.quote: Janik started as he had almost skewered his clanmate

events.summary: The Rakdos attack, and Janik holds his own in the fight.
events.quote: He held his own for a while

events.summary: Kal incinerates the Rakdos attackers with a blast of fire and passes out, having saved the day.
events.quote: Bolts of flame reduced the rest of the Rakdos to bone and ash in a blinding flash.
